title: StrategyAccountBinding
description: Authority for where and how a strategy executes. Replaces hardcoded per-worker constants.

execution_mode.description: LIVE requires explicit human authorization. SHADOW_ONLY never reaches broker submission.

ownership_namespace.description: Deterministic identity mapping into broker magic/comment fields.

magic_mapping.description: Stable per-binding magic derivation (not one global magic).

capital_policy_adapter.description: CapitalPolicyAdapter selector; null for strategy-native fixed research allocation.

broker_session_profile.description: BrokerSession profile selector for the bound account.

allowed_symbols.description: Broker symbols this binding may trade. Empty = none (fail closed).

enabled.description: Effective only when account identity matches and account is execution-enabled.
